## What's new

**Include subfolders now actually searches child folders.** Checking it in the Find bar walks the open folder and everything below it for matching names, instead of searching only the current folder.

Type while the checkbox is on: one word = one walk, debounced so you don't get a walk per keystroke. Reload re-runs an active search instead of replacing it with the folder listing. Uncheck or close the filter to go back to the plain list.

Nothing else changed in this build — no file operations, no navigation, no shortcuts. The 23 unit tests still pass.

## Installing

Download `RoachExplorer-v0.1.3a.zip`, unzip it, and drag **Roach Explorer** into Applications. The app is ad-hoc signed, so the first launch may need right-click → Open. Verify the download with the SHA-256 file next to it:

```sh
shasum -a 256 -c RoachExplorer-v0.1.3a.zip.sha256
```

Requires macOS 14 or later.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/HenzeLars/RoachExplorer/compare/v0.1.3...v0.1.3a
